name: Tetrahedral Normal Calculation
definition: A method to calculate smooth isosurface normals for tetrahedral meshes by computing vertex normals weighted by the volume of connected tetrahedra.
summary: Tetrahedral Normal Calculation computes smooth isosurface normals by weighting tetrahedron plane normals by volume, avoiding the visual discontinuities of flat shading while retaining standard Marching Tetrahedra topology.
